entries.name: Darkmoon Faire
entries.howToRaise: A traveling fair that showcases the weird and the extraordinary.  Often spotted in Elwynn Forest and Mulgore.

entries.name: Ironforge
entries.howToRaise: This Alliance capital is the pride of the Dun Morogh dwarves.  Home to King Magni.

entries.name: Everlook
entries.howToRaise: This trading post is run by the goblins of the Steamwheedle Cartel and it sits in the crossroads of Winterspring's main trade routes.

entries.name: The Defilers
entries.howToRaise: The Defilers seek to claim Arathi Basin's valuable resources for the Horde.

entries.name: Thunder Bluff
entries.howToRaise: Cairne Bloodhoof leads his people, the Proud Tauren, from this mighty Horde capital.

entries.name: Gelkis Clan Centaur
entries.howToRaise: These centaur have made their home in the southern region of Desolace.  Mortal enemies of the Magram Centaur.

entries.name: Ravenholdt
entries.howToRaise: This guild of thieves and assassins welcomes only those of extraordinary prowess into its fold.  Sworn rivals of the Syndicate.

entries.name: Bloodsail Buccaneers
entries.howToRaise: These bloodthirsty corsairs are the bane of many a merchant in the high seas.  Sworn enemies of Booty Bay.

entries.name: Cenarion Circle
entries.howToRaise: The druids of Cenarion Circle are guardians of nature and make their home in tranquil Moonglade.

entries.name: Ratchet
entries.howToRaise: Part of the Steamwheedle Cartel, this goblin city provides a neutral haven for those that wish to trade goods and services in the Barrens.

entries.name: Orgrimmar
entries.howToRaise: Founded by Thrall, this Horde capital city is home to many of the proud orc clans of Durotar.

entries.name: Darnassus
entries.howToRaise: The Alliance capital is populated by Night Elves and is located in the island of Teldrassil.  Ruled by the Priestess of the Moon, Tyrande Whisperwind.

entries.name: Wintersaber Trainers
entries.howToRaise: This small group of reclusive night elves raises and trains wintersabers in the Winterspring area.

entries.name: Darkspear Trolls
entries.howToRaise: This tribe of exiled trolls has joined forces with Thrall and the Horde.  They now call Durotar their home, which they share with their orc allies.

entries.name: Stormwind
entries.howToRaise: One of the last bastions of human power, this Alliance capital is ruled by the child king, Anduin Wrynn.

entries.name: Booty Bay
entries.howToRaise: This booming coastal city is run by Baron Revilgaz of the Blackwater Raiders.  Mortal enemies of the Bloodsail Buccaneers and part of the Steamwheedle Cartel.

entries.name: Gnomeregan Exiles
entries.howToRaise: The former denizens of Gnomeregan, now living in exile in Ironforge and in league with the Alliance.

entries.name: Shen'dralar
entries.howToRaise: A remnant of the once powerful elves living in Dire Maul, yet still wise and knowledgeable about great secrets.

entries.name: Warsong Outriders
entries.howToRaise: Fierce orcs of the Warsong Clan, locked in battle against the Silverwing Sentinels in Warsong Gulch.

entries.name: Syndicate
entries.howToRaise: A primarily human criminal organization that operates mostly out of the Alterac Mountains and Hillsbrad Foothills.

entries.name: Thorium Brotherhood
entries.howToRaise: The dwarves of the Thorium Brotherhood epitomize excellence in craftsmanship and are bent on unlocking the secrets of Blackrock Mountain.

entries.name: Frostwolf Clan
entries.howToRaise: The Frostwolf Clan seeks to drive out the dwarves of the Stormpike Expedition from Alterac Valley.

entries.name: DNT Test Reputation
entries.howToRaise: Will it break? Let's find out!

entries.name: Azeroth Commerce Authority
entries.howToRaise: Originally commissioned to facilitate trade across the Eastern Kingdoms, the ACA now maintains supply routes to Alliance forces worldwide.

entries.name: Durotar Supply and Logistics
entries.howToRaise: The Horde's robust supply network fuels its rapid expansion across Kalimdor and beyond.

entries.name: Argent Dawn
entries.howToRaise: An organization focused on protecting Azeroth from the threat of the Scourge.  Strongholds of the Argent Dawn can be found in the Eastern and Western Plaguelands.

entries.name: Gadgetzan
entries.howToRaise: Capital of the Steamwheedle Cartel and home to goblinhood's finest engineers, alchemists and merchants.

entries.name: Wildhammer Clan
entries.howToRaise: Though not a part of the Alliance, the dwarves of Aerie Peak have opened their doors to it and hold the Horde as enemies.

entries.name: Stormpike Guard
entries.howToRaise: The Stormpike Dwarves have set up residence in Alterac Valley, where they're locked in battle with the Frostwolf Orcs.

entries.name: Magram Clan Centaur
entries.howToRaise: These centaur have made their home in the eastern region of Desolace.  Mortal enemies of the Gelkis Centaur.

entries.name: Timbermaw Hold
entries.howToRaise: As one of the last uncorrupted furbolg tribes, the Timbermaw seek to preserve their spiritual ways and end the suffering of their brethren.

entries.name: The League of Arathor
entries.howToRaise: The League of Arathor seeks to reclaim lost land of Arathi Basin for their benefactors in Stormwind.

entries.name: Undercity
entries.howToRaise: Led by Sylvanas Windrunner, the Forsaken have joined a tenuous alliance with the Horde and established this capital in the vast depths under the Ruins of Lordaeron.

entries.name: Ravasaur Trainers
entries.howToRaise: The ravasaurs of Un'Goro Crater are incredibly deadly, but a few individuals have learned how to tame them.

entries.name: Cenarion Scouts
entries.howToRaise: The Cenarion Scouts are young nature enthusiasts dedicated to exploring and protecting the wilds of Azeroth.

entries.name: Bolder'ok Clan
entries.howToRaise: Exiled for betraying their false prophets, these former members of the Twilight's Hammer seek to forge their own path.

entries.name: Earthen Ring
entries.howToRaise: The Earthen Ring is a loose collective of Horde-aligned shamans and druids who seek to maintain and nurture the balance of nature on Azeroth.

entries.name: Guardians of Hyjal
entries.howToRaise: Charged with the protection and preservation of Mount Hyjal, this splinter faction of the Cenarion Circle welcomes any who are willing to push back the forces of evil.

entries.name: Barkskin Burrow
entries.howToRaise: The Barkskin are among the few furbolg tribes untouched by corruption, and dedicate themselves to safeguarding their spiritual heritage to bring harmony back to Hyjal.

entries.name: Silverwing Sentinels
entries.howToRaise: Staunch defenders of Ashenvale, locked in battle against the Warsong Outriders in Warsong Gulch.

entries.name: Brotherhood of the Horse
entries.howToRaise: Outcast members of Stormwind's cavalry, these former riders started anew in the unexplored lands along the eastern coast, establishing their home, new relationships, and trade routes.

entries.name: Kirin Tor
entries.howToRaise: An elite cadre of the most powerful wizards in the world and the ruling conclave of magi that leads the magical nation of Dalaran.

entries.name: Windshapers
entries.howToRaise: The Windshapers are shamanistic spiritual leaders of the Skyborne people on Zephras Isle. They honor the elements and seek to gain a better understanding of the nature of the elemental plane to protect the shen'dorei way of life within Skywall.

entries.name: High Order
entries.howToRaise: The High Order are the Skyborne descendants of the Highborne magisters of Eldre'Thalas. Having spent the past 10,000 years in the realm of Skywall, members of the High Order seek to reclaim the ancient arcane knowledge of their forebears.

entries.name: The Watchers
entries.howToRaise: An order of powerful jailers and marshals of night elf society. They stand vigilant to ensure that no threat can ever escape their extensive underground network of prisons.

entries.name: Darkspear Raiders
entries.howToRaise: Loyal to the troll nation, the Darkspear Raiders battle the Theramore Expeditionary Force for control of their ancestral Darkspear Islands.

entries.name: Theramore Expeditionary Force
entries.howToRaise: Loyal partisans for their city, the Theramore Expeditionary Force battles the Darkspear Raiders for control of the so-called Darkspear Islands.

entries.name: Powderfuse
entries.howToRaise: A strong arm of the Steamwheedle Cartel, this port is home to seafaring sailors and back-alley dealers spanning the eastern sea trading routes.

entries.name: Nightclaw Druids
entries.howToRaise: The secretive druids of the Shadowgale Forest. They operate independently, apart from any other faction on Zephras Isle.
